name: Rhythm
bio: An operative who fights with katana and rifle, built around fast gap-closers and a resource loop that converts Sanity into Electric Energy and back. Known for excellent mob-clearing.

skills.name: Volt Rush
skills.desc: Leaps forward, dealing Electro Damage to enemies along the path. When the [Electric Energy] point is no less than 30, consumes 30 points to increase the leap speed, the skill damage, and Rhythm's Damage Dealt by certain percentage.

skills.name: Electro Vortex
skills.desc: Deals Electro Damage to enemies within range and enters [Electro Surge] state, during which it continuously consumes Sanity. [Electro Surge] state ends when Sanity reaches 0 or when the skill is used again.

skills.name: Tactical Preservation
skills.desc: When consuming Sanity, converts a percentage of consumed Sanity into [Electric Energy]. The upper limit of [Electric Energy] is equal to the max Sanity.

skills.name: Poweroff Anxiety
skills.desc: When consuming [Electric Energy], converts 50% of the consumed [Electric Energy] into [Sanity].

skills.name: Thundering Nightbreaker
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby Electro teammate(s).
